Title: ML Platform Engineer
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. This role is pivotal in enabling enterprise-scale ML and generative AI capabilities by building secure, scalable, and automated infrastructure on Azure using Terraform and Azure DevOps. You’ll work at the intersection of ML, DevOps, and cloud engineering—building the foundation that supports real-time LLM inference, retraining, orchestration, and integration across JCI’s product and operations landscape. How You Will Do It ML Platform Engineering & MLOps (Azure-Focused) Build and manage end-to-end ML/LLM pipelines on Azure ML using Azure DevOps for CI/CD, testing, and release automation. Operationalize LLMs and generative AI solutions (e.g., GPT, LLaMA, Claude) with a focus on automation, security, and scalability. Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform, including provisioning compute clusters (e.g., Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Machine Learning compute), storage, and networking. Implement robust model lifecycle management (versioning, monitoring, drift detection) with Azure-native MLOps components. Infrastructure & Cloud Architecture Design highly available and performant serving environments for LLM inference using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Functions or App Services. Build and manage RAG pipelines using vector databases (e.g., Azure Cognitive Search, Redis, FAISS) and orchestrate with tools like LangChain or Semantic Kernel. Ensure security, logging, role-based access control (RBAC), and audit trails are implemented consistently across environments. Automation & CI/CD Pipelines Build reusable Azure DevOps pipelines for deploying ML assets (data pre-processing, model training, evaluation, and inference services). Use Terraform to automate provisioning of Azure resources, ensuring consistent and compliant environments for data science and engineering teams. Integrate automated testing, linting, monitoring, and rollback mechanisms into the ML deployment pipeline. Collaboration & Enablement Work closely with Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product Teams to deliver production-ready AI features. Contribute to solution architecture for real-time and batch AI use cases, including conversational AI, enterprise search, and summarization tools powered by LLMs. Provide technical guidance on cost optimization, scalability patterns, and high-availability ML deployments. Qualifications & Skills Required Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in ML engineering, MLOps, or platform engineering roles. Strong experience deploying machine learning models on Azure using Azure ML and Azure DevOps. Proven experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform in production environments. Technical Proficiency Proficiency in Python (PyTorch, Transformers, LangChain) and Terraform, with scripting experience in Bash or PowerShell. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, especially within Azure (AKS). Familiarity with CI/CD principles, model registry, and ML artifact management using Azure ML and Azure DevOps Pipelines. Working knowledge of vector databases, caching strategies, and scalable inference architectures. Soft Skills & Mindset Systems thinker who can design, implement, and improve robust, automated ML systems. Excellent communication and documentation skills—capable of bridging platform and data science teams. Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on delivery, reliability, and business impact. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLMOps, prompt orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel), and open-weight model deployment. Exposure to smart buildings, IoT, or edge-AI deployments. Understanding of governance, privacy, and compliance concerns in enterprise GenAI use cases. Certification in Azure (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure AI Engineer, Terraform Associate) is a plus.

Title: Ingeniero de Análisis de la Demanda y Sistema de Transporte | CDMX
Description: En Sener Mobility buscamos incorporar un/a profesional para el área de Análisis de la Demanda y Sistemas de Transporte en CDMX, con experiencia técnica y capacidad para trabajar en proyectos multidisciplinares de movilidad urbana e interurbana. Un equipo de profesionales dedicado al análisis y planificación del transporte, la modelación de la demanda, el diseño de redes y la evaluación de proyectos de movilidad. Trabajarás en proyectos tanto a nivel local como internacional, participando en estudios de demanda, desarrollo e implementación de modelos de transporte, análisis de sostenibilidad y soluciones de movilidad innovadoras. El entorno promueve la proactividad, el intercambio de ideas y la autonomía en equipos técnicos. ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? Análisis y modelación de sistemas de transporte público y privado: simulación de tránsito, modelado multimodal y evaluación de capacidad y nivel de servicio. Elaboración de estudios de demanda y escenarios de referencia para proyectos urbanos, metropolitanos e interurbanos. Evaluación técnica y económica de alternativas de movilidad, análisis de impactos ambientales y sociales, y apoyo en la definición de medidas de mitigación. Preparación de entregables: informes técnicos, memorias metodológicas, presentaciones para clientes y material de apoyo para procesos de consulta pública. Participación en propuestas y licitaciones: estimación de recursos, definición de alcance técnico y planificación de actividades. Coordinación con equipos de transporte, tráfico, infraestructuras y datos, así como interlocución con clientes y organismos públicos. ¿Qué necesitas para encajar en el puesto? Requisitos indispensables: Título universitario en Ingeniería de Transporte o Ingeniería Civil. Deseable contar con un post grado a fin Al menos 3–5 años de experiencia en modelación de demanda y/o análisis de sistemas de transporte en consultoría o administración pública. Conocimientos sólidos de herramientas y software de modelación (por ejemplo: VISUM, VISSIM, u otros similares) y experiencia con SIG (ArcGIS, QGIS). Capacidad para manejar grandes bases de datos, tratamiento y análisis de datos de movilidad (encuestas de movilidad, conteos, datos de sensores/MaaS, datos de telefonía/Big Data). Conocimientos de métodos cuantitativos: estadística, econometría, técnicas de calibración y validación de modelos. Nivel intermedio/alto de inglés valorado deseable Capacidad de trabajo en equipo, comunicación efectiva y orientación a resultados. Serán valorados: Experiencia en proyectos internacionales o en contexto latinoamericano. Experiencia en integración de datos de movilidad derivada de dispositivos móviles y plataformas de movilidad compartida. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Programa de bienestar físico y emocional y acceso a acciones formativas para tu desarrollo profesional. Estabilidad laboral y participación en proyectos de larga duración y alto valor técnico. Un ambiente colaborativo y multidisciplinar que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades, diversidad e inclusión. Apoyo en movilidad interna y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro del grupo Sener. Si te identificas con este perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo que impulsa soluciones de movilidad sostenible y eficiente, esperamos tu candidatura.

Description: Please apply uploading your resume in English. We are looking for Fluent English Speakers to work with US clients. Ready to launch your career in an environment where your ambition is celebrated and your ideas shape the future? These services help clients understand and lead their risk and insurance programs. You will work alongside premier actuaries and consultants on many projects. These include loss reserving, pricing, forecasting, and self-insurance analysis. You will also build your actuarial expertise and progress toward your professional credentials. The role includes: Deliver high-quality actuarial and analytical support across loss reserving, valuations, ratemaking, forecasting, self‑insurance, and data analysis to support existing and new client engagements Collect, organize, and analyze complex data to support brokerage business, proposals, and client decision‑making, translating technical results into clear, client‑ready insights Prepare accurate, well‑documented actuarial analyses, reports, presentations, and client correspondence that meet Aon standards for quality, clarity, and professional appearance Collaborate effectively with internal teams, project leads, and clients to ensure alignment on scope, priorities, timelines, and timely data collection, while fostering a strong “Aon United” approach Execute client service tasks efficiently by managing multiple priorities, meeting internal and external deadlines, applying established methodologies, and escalating anomalies as appropriate Support innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development by enhancing processes, applying new analytical techniques, leveraging Aon knowledge tools, and meeting utilization targets (85–100%) You’ll communicate constructively within your team, providing valuable feedback and embracing the same in return. Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, SharePoint, Adobe, Word, and PowerPoint is also required. Additionally: Proficiency in English at a C1 or C2 level. A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in actuarial science At least two or three years of relevant work experience; insurance industry preferred How This Opportunity Is Different This goes beyond a standard analytics job—this represents your platform for making a difference and progress. You will contribute to analytical projects like data management, loss forecasting, accruals, and self-insurance analysis. You’ll enhance assignment results by improving operational procedures and balancing shifting priorities with flexibility, ensuring the client team’s workload is always supported. At Aon, growth isn’t just encouraged—it’s expected! You’ll have access to a host of opportunities for developing your personal and professional skills, from online training and Aon courses to seminars and certification programs so you can learn and grow. Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate. You will manage junior colleagues to develop insights that assist clients in making more informed strategic and investment decisions in the Mexican power market. The successful applicant will combine technical strength with a strong track record of leadership and performance in team-oriented environments. You will work in a dynamic, intellectually stimulating, and demanding yet supportive environment. You will enjoy autonomy, the opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector, and to further grow into an industry expert under the guidance of directors with deep experience addressing major strategic issues at the world’s leading advisory firms. The position suits an experienced associate or manager from a top-tier strategic or economic consultancy, energy company, financial services company, or knowledge-focused firm or institution. The successful candidate will combine technical ability with a strong track record of leadership and dependable performance in team-oriented environments. Key Responsibilities Manage workstreams and project teams in developing timely and rigorous quantitative analyses to enhance clients’ decision making. Contribute to Aurora’s product development, by identifying new opportunities, developing new business and expanding our capabilities. Engage with clients to thoroughly understand their requirements. Communicate findings to clients as well as to the wider public (media, webinars, …) What we are looking for Required attributes: 3 to 6 years of experience , preferably at a leading consultancy, energy company, financial services company, or other knowledge-driven firm or institution Degree in a relevant quantitative field, with a strong academic record and outstanding Grade Point Average Ability to analyse, interpret, and derive insight from complex quantitative data and information. Ability to communicate and collaborate with both technically and non-technically minded parties. Self-starter, entrepreneurial mind-set, and desire to grow the business. Excellent written communication Proficiency in English (C1 level) Written and spoken fluency in Spanish (C2 level) Willingness to travel Desirable attributes: Demonstrated working knowledge of power markets and associated policy framework. It would be highly advantageous to have existing knowledge of renewables and/or flexible energy technologies (e.g. batteries); and knowledge of the Mexican power market. Demonstrated success in client-facing positions. Competence in advanced data analytics (e.g. Python, Advanced Excel) Relevant Master’s degree To apply, please submit your CV in English What we offer The opportunity to substantially influence major decisions in the energy sector. Direct engagement with clients through Aurora conferences, workshops and webinars. The opportunity to grow into a publicly visible industry expert. A fun, informal and international work culture. A competitive salary package. Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills. The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership and pregnancy and maternity We will review applications as they are received. Salary will be competitive with experience. To apply, please submit your CV in English , a brief cover letter, your salary expectations and state your earliest possible start date.

Demanda Delivery Plan. Demanda Primario PRINCIPALES FUNCIONES Coordinar Proceso S&OP 2.0 y Planeación de la Demanda ¿Qué hace? Gestionar el proceso de Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP 2.0) en sus tres etapas: Data Gathering, Forecast Consensus y Junta S&OP trimestral con Top Management. ¿Cómo lo hace? Coordinando en conjunto con las áreas Comercial y de Finanzas en la construcción y conciliación del forecast en tres niveles (N1 Total, N2 por Vertical, N3 por Cuenta TOP), con una proyección máximo a 3 meses. ¿Para qué lo hace? Para alinear el volumen de demanda proyectado con la capacidad operativa disponible, anticipar riesgos de saturación, garantizar los niveles de servicio y habilitar la toma de decisiones financieras y operativas con visibilidad estratégica. Generar el Presupuesto Anual y Estrategia de Capacidad ¿Qué hace? Lidera la construcción del presupuesto anual de la Dirección de Operaciones y los FCST trimestrales, así como los escenarios de capacidad necesarios para operar la demanda comercial proyectada. ¿Cómo lo hace? Con base en modelos estadísticos automatizados, históricos operativos y la información consolidada de las áreas de Ventas y Finanzas; definiendo recursos de headcount, unidades y gasto en función de los volúmenes proyectados por plaza, tipo de cliente y línea de negocio (EME, Cargo, ECA). ¿Para qué lo hace? Para asegurar la rentabilidad de la operación, el balance costo-servicio y la disponibilidad de recursos anticipada especialmente en temporada alta, con una tolerancia máxima de desvío del +/- 10% plan vs real en variables controlables. Identificar posibles riesgos en el comportamiento de clientes. ¿Qué hace? Identifica posibles riesgos y variaciones en el comportamiento de la demanda de los clientes. ¿Cómo lo hace? Mediante el seguimiento diario a la operación, con énfasis en clientes estratégicos, y el análisis de información histórica utilizando métodos estadísticos sobre bases de datos de consumo, segmentadas por tipo de cliente, tipo de empaque, plaza y origen-destino. ¿Para qué lo hace? Para anticipar cambios en la demanda, determinar los flujos de carga, planificar la capacidad operativa y prevenir posibles saturaciones o colapsos en los Centros de Trabajo. Asegurar el cumplimiento de la estrategia operativa. ¿Qué hace? Asegura el cumplimiento de la estrategia operativa establecida por la organización. ¿Cómo lo hace? Mediante el monitoreo de indicadores de desempeño, el seguimiento a los planes operativos, la coordinación con las áreas involucradas y la implementación de acciones preventivas y correctivas para atender desviaciones. ¿Para qué lo hace? Para garantizar el cumplimiento de los objetivos operativos, mantener los niveles de servicio comprometidos, optimizar el uso de los recursos y contribuir al logro de los resultados del negocio. TOMA DE DECISIONES Decisiones Autónomas Del Puesto Definir las capacidades operativas en los periodos y en cada una de las plazas. Ajustar los escenarios de capacidad operativa (headcount, unidades, rutas) en función de cambios en la demanda. Ajustar el gasto operativo dentro del presupuesto aprobado ante cambios en la demanda. Definir conexiones en transporte primario en función a la demanda para periodos y evitar desviaciones.
